verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs mention Cowork handling 'bigger, multi-step tasks' and delivering 'completed to-dos', plus marketing claims that it can 'automate repetitive tasks, no coding required' and 'hand off repetitive work'. That suggests some delegated autonomous execution, but nothing shows user-configured automations running in the background. Browse with Copilot is explicitly real-time and supervised, with users watching each step, so it does not count as background autonomy. missing for 10: documented scheduled or triggered automations, evidence that tasks run unattended in the background, setup/configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
